data.name: Cancer Crusher USA
data.detailed_description:
Cancer Crusher USA

Crush cancer. Build momentum. See how well you can handle it.

Cancer Crusher USA is a fast-paced 2.5D side-scrolling action game where you drive a powerful monster truck across the United States, crushing cancer wherever it appears. The game is built around speed, multitasking, and player skill — easy to pick up, but increasingly intense the better you play.

Gameplay Loop Explained

Cancer Crusher USA is about moving forward and crushing cancer while balancing your attention between foreground threats and background opportunities.

Foreground action: Player drivers forward, left to right, switching between 2 available lanes as necessary to evade, jump over or crush targets in the road. Crush cancer in the road to gain a significant speed boost and regain some health.

Background: While the foreground requires most of your attention to succeed, the background contains cancer targets as well, that provide additional resources when defeated.

Cancer Crusher USA has a unique targeting system, inspired by the legendary Sega Saturn classic *Panzer Dragoon*.

Simply hold the targeting button and sweep your cursor across the screen. Enemies become marked for destruction one after another. Release the button, and a barrage of fireworks streaks through the battlefield, curving toward every locked target before detonating in a spectacular chain of explosions - putting on a firework show!

Easy to Learn. Fun to Master.

The game is designed around a simple idea:
keep the player moving forward while giving them just enough control to make every moment matter.

Movement is largely automated, allowing you to focus on what matters most:

  • targeting enemies

  • reacting to obstacles

  • maintaining momentum

Using your cursor, you can quickly move across cancer enemies in the background to lock onto multiple targets.

  • Tap to launch fireworks at a single target

  • Hold the launch button and sweep across multiple enemies to lock them in

  • Release to launch a burst of fireworks at all selected targets at once

It’s fast, responsive, and extremely satisfying — especially as the game speeds up.

Built for Flow and Multitasking

Cancer Crusher USA is all about managing attention.

If you focus too much on avoiding obstacles, you’ll miss opportunities to destroy cancer.
If you focus too much on targeting, you risk losing control.

That balance is the game.

Crushing cancer — whether on the road or with fireworks — gives you short bursts of speed.
The better you play, the faster the game becomes.
The faster it gets, the harder it is to keep up.

Dynamic Roads Across America

Your journey begins in California, crossing the Golden Gate Bridge, and continues east across the United States. Each environment introduces new mechanics and variations in gameplay.

Ribbon Roads

Smooth, flowing highways where you can enjoy the ride and focus on targeting enemies in the background. Build momentum and chain together clean runs.

Tumor Tunnels

Tight, circular environments where you rotate around the path to avoid incoming threats while launching fireworks at flying cancer enemies. These sections demand constant awareness and quick reactions.

Helix Highways

Massive cylindrical roads where your vehicle is magnetized to the surface. Rotate around the structure while moving forward, crushing cancer, avoiding rotating spike balls, and targeting enemies both on and off the road.

These sections often descend into large cave systems — some of the most visually dynamic areas in the game — where the scale increases and the pressure builds.

Enemies and Pressure

Cancer isn’t just static — it fights back.

  • Flying enemies chase and attack

  • Rotating hazards block your path

  • Large enemy monster trucks pursue you during high-speed chase sequences

In these moments, you’ll switch between lanes, crush cancer in your path to maintain speed, and launch fireworks to slow enemies down.

Miss too many opportunities, and they’ll catch up.

Constant Movement, Dynamic Camera

You are always moving forward.

The camera shifts dynamically between:

  • side-scrolling views

  • third-person perspectives

Each transition is designed to enhance the feeling of motion and scale, making the game just as engaging to watch as it is to play.

Score and Progression

Each level ends at a hospital, where your run is completed with a firework celebration.

Your performance is measured by:

  • how much cancer you crushed

  • how well you maintained momentum

  • how effectively you handled the increasing speed

Crushing cancer on the road gives immediate speed boosts.
Destroying enemies with fireworks creates collectible energy that returns to you, extending your momentum.

Perfect runs are possible — but not required.

A Game With Purpose

Cancer Crusher USA is part of a larger mission.

50% of all gross profit from game and merchandise sales will be donated to cancer-related charities.

If you’d like to support the development of the full game, Cancer Crusher USA will soon be live on Kickstarter and Gamefound. Your support helps fund continued development, formation of the studio as an LLC, marketing, and expansion to additional platforms including PlayStation, Nintendo, and mobile devices on Apple and Android.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or later.
  • Processor: Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD series card or higher.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card.
  • VR Support: No VR support.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or later.
  • Processor: Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD series card or higher.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card.
  • VR Support: No VR support.
